Introduction

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P2, which must be performed 
every twenty years as indicated by Y20 in the above title block.

Condition of CB during Work: 1- Circuit breaker out of service and must 
be isolated.

2- Gas compartments need not 
be opened.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah kamel 
Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), 
tested by eng. 
Sahar Mahamed Ali, accepted by electrical general director eng. Said 
Mahmoud Hessain 
Farag, 
revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control engineer Adel Abdel Kader El-Naggar, and approved by eng.
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady; head sector of Ataka PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety belts 
 ... etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The circuit breaker must be isolated and grounded from both sides..

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Gas filling device.
Cleaning tools.
Safety belt, safety helmet.
Normal tools are needed.

Two precision pressure gauge one for oil (0-600) bar and the other for SF6 gas 
 (0-15) bar (class 0.6).

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
General Check

Follow the 
 same procedures that have been carried out in the minor maintenance procedures 
 in addition to the following procedures :-
Drawing off the SF6 Gas

items:
It is recommended to draw off the SF6 with service unit so that it can be used 
 again almost completely for the future filling.

The service unit has all the facilities for drawing off and filling the SF6 
 gas.
The condition of the sf6 gas in the service unit should be checked in advance.

sections.text:
Open one interrupter unit and 
remove the contact tube

Visual Check of contact system 
and Blast Cylinder

If any irregularities are found 
proceed as in next step (3)

items: This check is made with out the interrupter unit having to be dismantled.
Contact support with contact tube is removed only.
Only open and check one interrupter unit of the circuit breaker.

If the electrical stressing is known, check the interrupter unit with the 
 highest load.

If the examination of the contact / guide tube shows that both must be 
 renewed, the gas gap must subsequently be checked, along with the off centre 
 condition and the proper alignment of the contact system.

sections.text:
If any Irregularities are Found 
in step (2) open all Interrupter units and Remove the Contact tube then proceed 
as in step (2)
Replace Filter

items:
It is necessary to protect the filter material against the atmospheric 
 humidity

The material must not be directly exposed to the open air for prolonged period 
 of time.

It is supplied in closed tin vacuum that is produced which is recognizable by 
 hissing when opened.

If the tin is leaky, no vacuum will be produced so must not be used because 
 filter capacity will be inadequate for maintenance interval stated.

sections.text: To Change the Filter

items: Unscrew the filter chamber
Remove the disc
Insert the filter bag in the filter chamber
Install the chamber with the disc using the new sealing ring supplied
The circuit breaker must be evacuated.

sections.text: Filling the SF6 Gas

items:
The breaker may be filled only by appropriately qualified personal, and 
 accordance with the SF6 filling curve ( see under 1-00800- technical data) .

To fill the breaker with gas , service unit can be used since this contains 
 all the necessary facilities .

If the service unit is not available, the SF6 can be taken direct from the gas 
 cylinder using the SF6 filling device.

We must use safety valve with the nominal opening pressure of 8 bar with the 
 filling device that prevent the pressure compartments being overstressed due 
 to an impermissible high pressure.

A vacuum pump must be available for evacuating the breaker prior to SF6 being 
 filled in .

sections.text: Filling by using a Service Unit

items: Connect the service unit to the maintenance flangeW1 figure 1 .
Evacuate the breaker to ≤ 20 mbar
Switch over the service unit to filling.

The values of the filling pressure and the operating dependent on temperature 
 that taken from the diagram (SF6 filling curve and operating values of density 
 monitor section 1-0080, technical data)

Connect the maintenance flange of filling device to maintenance flange W1 
 of the breaker.

Open slowly the valve on the pressure reducer with the vent valve closed to 
 prevent the fitting icing up. (Check the filling pressure by reference to the 
 precision pressure gauge.

At the ambient temperature other than +20 C, the SF6 filling pressure must 
 be taken from the diagram (section 1-0080, technical data ) (care must be 
 taken that the filling pressure depend on the ambient temperature is correct)
The filling tolerance may be up to 0.3 bar over the nominal pressure curve.

When filling is complete, unscrew the filling device and close maintenance 
 flange

sections.text: NOTE: Make sure all parts are cleaned.
Figure 2: SF6 Filling Device W348

Vent the Hydraulic System and 
Bringing the Pressure to the Nominal Level

items: The hydraulic system must be vented every time oil has been filled in.
The procedures are as the following:

Vent the in tank chamber of the pump at standstill after the oil has been 
 filled in .to do so , slacken the vent plug (14.33 fig.3) on the pump , move 
 it back and forth and keep it open until only bubble free oil emergency then 
 retighten the plug .

Keep 
 the pump running idly for 10 minutes with the pressure release valve14.37 
 (fig 
 10) must be opened.
Switch off the pump and vent again as described under step (1)

sections.text: M1: Motor
14.33 Oil pump

items:
Switch on the pump and vent as follows with the pressure release valve 14.37 
 open.

Open the vent value (13.6 fig. 4) on the distributor of the 
 hydraulic storage cylinder (as shown in fig. 5 ) and leave it open 
 until oil without any air bubble comes out.
Figure 4

pressure release valve must be 
 closed , when the nominal pressure reached the hydraulic pump is switched off 
 by the pressure monitor in conjunction with a time relay if, after a prolonged 
 operating time, the pump is running longer than at the beginning of the 
 operating time, pump venting should be repeated. Close the pressure release 
 valve, switch on the oil pump and bring the hydraulic operating mechanism to 
 nominal pressure. Make about 5 trial operation after a setting time of 10 
 minute. Release the pressure.

Then check the oil level a gain with the oil un pressurized and replenish up 
 to the filling mark if necessary.

sections.text: NOTES:

items:
Only pressurize the operating mechanism when the circuit breaker has filled 
 with sf6 gas.

Trial operations must not be made without the breaker having been filled with 
 sf6 gas at nominal pressure.

sections.text:
Check of the breaker for sf6 leaks: - for nominal pressure of sf6 gas 
(see table in sec. 1-0080, technical data)

items:
When the breaker has been filled , all connected elements should be subjected 
 to a leakage test by using:
Leakage detector
Leakage detector spray from WOBST
Soap solution (if this is not available)

sections.text: Check all terminal blocks
Check the terminal connection for firm seating and terminal for damage
Measure of the humidity and air content of the SF6 filling.
Measuring the SF6 gas humidity content

items:
Before putting the breaker into operation , the humidity of the SF6 must be 
 checked for this a commercially dew point measuring instrument can be used .

The maximum permissible dew point temperature at operating pressure 
 corresponding to the permissible humidity are stated below

If the dew point temperature is below -100 C during the operation 
 but not below -15 0 C the measurement should be repeated after 
 two or three months in order to test the effect of the static filters
If there is no reduction in the humidity , we must use a new filter

sections.text: Measuring the SF6 gas air content

items:
When the breaker has been filled with a new gas and following maintenance the 
 air content should not be more than 5% to be measure with the sf6 percentage 
 instrument (3-027) from Dilo
This instrument measure the sf6 volume (at least 95%) .

sections.text: Replace permanent sleeves in the driving rods.
Only for versions (EG) with common hydraulic operating mechanism .
